_note: Hand-authored, human-auditable provision graphs for 3 real CE plans, derived from the atlas clauses (data/policies/ce_atlas_raw/). This is the 'compile the policy once' artifact system C uses. Each provision: id, type (coverage|exclusion|condition|limit), verbatim clause, applies_when (the fact pattern that makes it relevant), effect.

provisions.clause: repair the defect at no charge, using new parts or parts that are equivalent to new
provisions.applies_when: a hardware defect / spontaneous failure with no external cause, within term

provisions.clause: accidental damage from handling resulting from an unexpected and unintentional external event
provisions.applies_when: damage from a drop, spill, or other unintentional external event

provisions.clause: less than eighty percent (80%)
provisions.applies_when: a battery capacity / degradation claim
provisions.effect: covered ONLY if measured capacity is below 80%; otherwise not a covered defect

provisions.clause: Screen-Only Damage: US$29; All Other Damage: US$99
provisions.applies_when: any approved ADH claim

provisions.clause: your Plan Term is two (2) years
provisions.applies_when: the device is older than 2 years from purchase

provisions.clause: Theft and misplacement are not covered under this Plan
provisions.applies_when: the device was stolen, lost, or misplaced (and the customer is NOT on the Theft & Loss tier)

provisions.clause: normal wear and tear
provisions.applies_when: gradual deterioration from normal use (loose ports, minor degradation)

provisions.clause: reckless, abusive, willful or intentional conduct
provisions.applies_when: the damage was caused on purpose / by abuse

provisions.clause: cosmetic damage that does not affect functionality
provisions.applies_when: scratches/dents that do not impair function

provisions.clause: a mechanical or electrical failure or other defect
provisions.applies_when: spontaneous functional failure with no external cause

provisions.clause: a failure due to accidental damage from handling
provisions.applies_when: damage from a drop or spilled liquid (accident tier)

provisions.clause: a leaking Product battery (or any other leaking substance on or within the Product)
provisions.applies_when: the battery is swollen/leaking, or internal liquid/corrosion is from a leaking battery

provisions.clause: Cosmetic damage, including but not limited to scratches, dents, or housing cracks
provisions.applies_when: scratches/dents/housing cracks that do not impair function

provisions.clause: Any intentional dishonest, fraudulent or criminal act
provisions.applies_when: damage caused on purpose

provisions.clause: A Product that was lost, stolen or damaged (when Damage is not part of Your Coverage Type)
provisions.applies_when: the device was stolen or lost and the customer is NOT on the Theft & Loss tier
provisions.effect: excluded unless on the Theft & Loss tier

provisions.clause: a maximum of three (3) accidental damage from handling claims applies in a 12-month period
provisions.applies_when: this would be the 4th+ ADH claim in 12 months
a gradual battery-degradation claim with no leak and no defect evidence
provisions.effect: the master terms do not address normal battery degradation -> ambiguous; needs human/diagnostic

provisions.clause: Standard Plans cover product breakdowns and malfunctions during normal use
provisions.applies_when: spontaneous functional failure

provisions.clause: life's accidents like drops and spills
provisions.applies_when: drop/spill/immersion damage (Accident Plan)

provisions.clause: An Allstate Protection Plan must be bought within 30 days of item purchase
provisions.applies_when: the plan was purchased more than 30 days after the item

provisions.clause: Accidental Damage Protection Plans are only eligible for new items
provisions.applies_when: the covered item was bought used/refurbished
provisions.effect: ADH plan ineligible for the item

provisions.clause: Neither plan covers intentional damage, loss, theft, or commercial use
provisions.applies_when: the device was lost or stolen

provisions.clause: Neither plan covers intentional damage, loss, theft, or commercial use
provisions.applies_when: the device is used for a business / commercial purpose

provisions.clause: Neither plan covers intentional damage, loss, theft, or commercial use
provisions.applies_when: damage caused on purpose

provisions.clause: Cosmetic damage and normal wear and tear are not covered
provisions.applies_when: scratches/dents that do not impair function
